method: eslint --format json; backend = warnings over 'main/' and 'shared/' at repo root; frontend = warnings over '.' in frontend/ (frontend-local eslint). Counted the same way scripts/ci/check-lint-budget.cjs counts them in CI.
policy: Ratchet: lint-budget.json ceilings may never exceed these counts without re-recording this baseline, and any re-recording requires a reviewed rationale. Warning counts above the ceiling fail CI; reductions are always allowed and the ceiling may be lowered to the new count. tests/lint-budget-ratchet.test.cjs pins these values so a silent ceiling raise fails the test suite.
